reviews.text:
I’ve been bringing my pets to Medical District Vet for many years, and for the past 2–3 years, I’ve had the pleasure of having Dr. Hampton care for my two cats. She and her staff are incredibly kind, compassionate, and always take the time to clearly explain what needs to be done and what to expect.

This has meant so much to me, especially with my cat Penelope, who is FIV-positive and has difficulty healing. Penelope has had to go through more than most cats, including multiple visits and procedures. Dr. Hampton takes the time to talk through every option, explain what we can expect, and work with me to create the best plan for Penelope. I never feel rushed, and I always feel like we are making these decisions together, with Penelope’s best interest at the center of everything. What makes it even more special is the love and attention the staff gives Penelope. Even after everything she has been through, she feels so much love and comfort there that she struts around the clinic like she owns the place! That means so much to me as her cat mom.

Medical District Vet’s across the board has a great team, great doctors, and fair/reasonable pricing compared to other places I’ve been. I highly recommend Dr. Hampton for her thoroughness, innovative approach, communication, and genuine compassion for my cats. Thank you Dr. Hampton for your exceptional care.

Dr. Kritzman and staff took amazing care of our dog from her visit to a more recent surgical procedure. I couldn’t be more happy to work with a spectacular veterinary team! Dr. Kritzman is so kind and really took the time to answer any questions we had and was very thorough in her care of our pup. So grateful to have found such a wonderful provider and team. Their pricing is very reasonable and we appreciated the transparency and honesty. Highly, highly recommend booking an appointment here!
Fantastic qualified doctors n veterinary personnel great handling of my Sally,kind and patient service received ,explained my questions well detailed.Thanks For Your Services🐾 …

Carmen L was instantly kind and caring and attentive as soon as I waked in for my cat Hercules. Thank you Carmen for your important help! And Jesse at the cat desk and Sheila at the dog desk are just as kind and hard working. This clinic is wonderful bc they have staff who actually listen and care and they have a separate section for cats and dogs in case of anxiety for your fur babies. It’s clean and they have treats for cats and dogs. They also have a nice drink station with water and hot beverages. Since it’s a teaching hospital I really like that they care about learning and keeping up with the best practices. There is free parking and you look for the orange signs to park on the right spots. Hercules thanks you. At age 15 he is still kicking but I want him to be his best for many more years.
Great vets for our cats
Truly the best. Best prices and care. Flexibility to help give you advice via email. 4 yrs and don’t plan on leaving anytime soon!

I was Reccomended to come here from another patient, and when I contacted the front desk, the front desk receptionist, Friday the 30th, was so unprofessional. She was rude and not very helpful.
First impressions mean a great deal, and I was told in my mind that this was not where my pets need to be.
They are fantastic!! At Medical District Veterinary Clinic. I highly recommend!!!
How do I make an appointment to vaccinate my cat and what is the price?
Staff is kind and helpful

Front desk: angels
Vet Techs: incredible
Veterinarians: empathetic & compassionate

We are so grateful for this practice and everything that ya’ll do!

The absolute BEST Veterinary office!! My Shiloh has really bad anxiety around other dogs. They were so patient with him and they let me bring him in as the last appointment it was great. Along with 50 questions I had they answered them all and 25 phone calls of questions their patience is impressive! Thank you for all being SO AMAZING ❤️❤️❤️ Shiloh loves you guys and I do too!

10/10 do recommend! The staff is very friendly, accommodating, and knowledgeable from reception to vets and assistance. I appreciate the communication and transparency along the way during the visits. Compared to other vet offices this place is very affordable, but still provides high quality care. So glad they were recommended to me a year ago, this is definitely our forever vet home

This was by far the best vet experience we could have hoped for our anxious pittie. For the first time ever, I was able to have an extended conversation and learn more about my dog’s health. They offered accommodations that helped our dog Daisy be more comfortable such as a private room entrance (skipping the lobby), happy visits with their amazing tech Sam, and endless treats and toys. They are not kidding when they say “fear free.” I feel like we found a true partnership in keeping Daisy happy and healthy. Thank you Dr. K, Sam and team!
Excellent veterinarian! Great for regular exams and planned procedures.

I scheduled a dental procedure for my cat right at checkout after my cat’s appointment (with the male vet tech/assistant).. I called night before procedure day because I never received any dental procedure instructions which they said they would. Turns out, he never even put my cat in the schedule.. now next available dental appointment is two months out. Thank goodness it wasn’t an emergent case. This makes me question their team and service a bit..
Highly recommend this clinic! Reasonable pricing, great doctors and surgeons. My cat recently had her mass removed. Fast email response and phone call.

I can’t say enough good things about Medical District Veterinary Clinic. They took wonderful care of my Pitbull for years up until she passed last year, and even though I’ve since moved farther away, I still bring my senior coonhound here because I trust them completely.

My coonhound is a big boy (104 lbs) and can be very anxious and reactive at vet visits, but the staff handles him with so much patience and care. He definitely doesn’t make things easy, and they still do an amazing job every time.

The entire team is kind, professional, and genuinely cares about the animals they treat. Their pricing is also very reasonable, which I really appreciate.

I’ve never had a bad experience here and wouldn’t trust anyone else with my dogs.

had such a great experience earlier this year with Dr. Calderon and Crystal when I brought my dog here for the first time to get his annual vaccines and some other routine meds up to date. Front desk staff were wonderful and friendly. I was so relieved that they let my anxious dog stay with me through the entire visit and they did such a great job implementing fear free techniques so that he could have a full exam, blood work, and all his vaccines updated. As a former vet tech I am very discerning about the care my dog receives and the staff here knocked it out of the park, truly. Communication before and after the visit has been thorough and prompt, including getting prescriptions at an outside pharmacy called in impressively fast.

Dr. Calderon and Crystal were also excellent when it came to hearing my concerns, addressing them thoroughly, and asking good questions to get a good picture of my dog's history. Thanks again to the team for taking such good care of me and Champer!

I'll note too that if you're a fellow pet owner whose wallet has been feeling the skyrocketing cost of vet care these last few years, this place will ease that pain a little. I never expect high quality care to be cheap, but for the quality of care here you really can't beat their prices within the city.
They killed my cat. The new vet was more concerned about her time at the gym, than my cat.
Great service.  Pets are treated with love, empathy and respect!

Thank you to this team. Everyone is always so friendly and helpful. They are always so thorough since I’m a new dog mom. Crystal the vet tech was so awesome yesterday from the phone call and the visit .. kritzman is the vet and she’s awesome too

Thank you so Much for being So Kind! Doesn’t always have to be so hard and you made it so much better you helped me help Coco cross the rainbow bridge and I’ll never forget how kind you were and you didn’t have to be

After extensive research upon moving to the city 3 years ago, we chose Dr. Ana Valbuena. She is an excellent and highly competent USDA certified veterinarian who keeps up with the latest research and methodologies in her field.

Dr. Valbuena’s bedside manner with our anxious dog (see below) has made routine vet visits a breeze. She is the ONLY vet my dog has ever liked and has consistently gone above and beyond to ensure our dog’s comfortability from the very first appointment. She throughly answers any questions we have.

The support staff and vet technicians are also incredible! It is very easy to schedule an appointment as someone always picks up. Medication is available immediately. Staff are responsive to emails. Their text system sends timely reminders. The waiting room and exam rooms are pristine.

I especially appreciate that Medical District Vet Clinic is affiliated with University of Illinois and not private equity investment. We have found their prices to be competitive yet fair. They do not suggest erroneous treatments and are transparent about costs.

We go out of our way to take our dog here and it is 100% worth it for the quality of care received.
They love animals and are kind,caring,professional with pet owners
Thank you for taking time to post a review. We appreciate it.

Dr. Hampton and the team at Medical District Veterinary Clinic are incredible! They fit our 6 year old dog with an infection in last minute and treated us with so much kindness and patience. They took the time to explain everything and made sure our pup felt comfortable the entire time. We’re so grateful for Dr. Hampton’s compassion and expertise, and for the entire team’s support!
Tulip (dog) loves the Medical District Veterinary Clinic! Great customer service, knowledgeable, and so friendly. Highly recommend.
Awesome and friendly staff, they really care about you and your pet. Doctor Sullivan along with the other veterinarians are wonderful.

I’ve been coming here for my two dogs’ checkups, exams, vaccines, etc., and it’s always been a great experience. But today I was really disappointed.

I had an appointment with a tech for vaccines and nail trimming. While I was there, I asked if they could do a sanitary shave. They said yes, and since I usually do it at a grooming place but was already there, I figured why not.

Everything seemed fine until both of my dogs came back with a really bad sanitary shave, especially in the back. At checkout, I politely asked if that result was normal because my dogs have had this done many times before and never looked like that. The front desk person was kind and offered to take one of them back to fix it, but also mentioned that this isn’t a grooming center.

When my dog came back, it looked even worse. I don’t know if the person just didn’t know how to do it properly or did it out of frustration, but the result was honestly terrible. Later at the dog park, several people asked what had happened to Brisa because it was so noticeable.

I get that this isn’t a grooming center, and that’s totally fine. But then they shouldn’t offer this service at all. Now it’ll take months for the hair to grow back, and I’ll probably have to pay a groomer to fix the look.

Really disappointing experience this time.
(It looks way worse than in the picture)
Thank you for taking the time to submit a review. We appreciate it!

Great clinic to establish your pets care. The Veterinary Doctors are great. The front desk service needs a little more attention but it always seems there lacking front office support. But no one is ignored.
Excellent service, the clinic is very clean, I recommend it 100%.

We used this service nearly 2 years.  We have decided no more.

This practice is now dominated by greed in its pricing. We found that its charge is even more than some of our emergency visits in the middle of the night.

It's pricing is simply not acceptable.

An infection of a side of a foot has caused $2400 so far.  For today's visit, it was $641 with a bandage and 4 different pills.

We can no longer trust Dr Amanda Hampton for her coldness and her service.

Today's visit is our last one.
Great vet clinic and reasonably priced. They really are transparent and care about your pet.
Caring and knowledgeable staff
Dr Angelica is very professional and animal lover strongly recommend.
Cecilia loves UIC Veterinary Clinic and the staff is amazing with her being 140 lbs at one year and three months.

Angelica Calderon was my puppy's dvm. My Shihpoo was a healthy 2 month 2.5 lb and she received her first vaccines on Thursday. I believe they gave her too high of a dose for her little body or maybe she was too underweight to receive a vaccine in which they should have known that because she died two days later!!!  I'm so heartbroken and I blame this vet clinic. Never once did they call to follow up to see how she was doing because maybe if they would have done so they would have been able to save my little puppy from dying!! And then she finally calls me back after I left a message and wants to point the blame on me rather than having true sympathy and compassion for her mistake. I do not know how Angelica Calderon can be a vet. I do not know how she can be ok with the fact she just cost a puppy her life. And then to try to point the blame on me the owner of this little puppy. She was healthy before she had this vaccine. Angelica even said it herself so yes be aware of having your pet treated by that vet. She clearly does not know what she’s doing because how can my puppy loose her life by a vaccine. It was too much of a dose for a little 2 lb puppy!!!
I regret trusting this clinic and that vet. Please do research before you take your pet here. Your pet can loose his or her life and I don’t want that to happen to anyone.

Please please be aware!!

Since I cannot respond back to their response I decided to add it to my original post. It’s truly unprofessional that the owner of this clinic responded to my review and has never once emailed or called but I guess imagine is everything for this place. Because it is also unprofessional and illegal to post patients history. Especially when that has nothing to do with what happened or occurred in the ONLY puppy they treated. When the vet saw my puppy she was healthy. They said she was healthy and if they understood my concern then they should have waited for her to get vaccinated but apparently a 2.5 lb puppy could receive the same dose as a giant German shepherd. Because adults and babies receive the same dose. Right! This was a joke and I wish I had read the other reviews about this clinic and I wish I did my own research rather than to trust this place. I’m so upset and disappointed because one thing is for sure you cannot undo death. But rather than accepting the blame and just saying I’m so sorry this never happened no they just want to pass the blame onto the owner.

This place is so unprofessional and it’s so sad because I never had a problem up until I met Angelica Calderon. Death is not a joke and all I wanted was true answers and change to how they conduct this clinic. Because no one should loose their pets life after receiving a vaccine.
Everyone we had contact with were compassionate and caring.  The vets are the best.  Worth the time to travel further for very good pet care.
The most important thing is that they speak Spanish, they are very caring and compassionate with animals, and they provide excellent service.
Always great service. Everything well explained and very tender care with my senior dogs as well as my puppies. Love the affiliation with the University of Illinois and their vet school.

Can't say enough great things about Dr Kritzman and the whole staff there. They're friendly, responsive, and spend a lot of time with you and your pet during appointment times. And the prices are really competitive. Highly recommend!

Couldn't ask for better. Prices are very reasonable. The staff is extremely knowledgeable. It's spotless and we have never had to wait. We have been put directly into exam room upon arrival. Then it is about 5 to 10 minutes until you see the Vet and Vet Tech.
Also, the do not do any testing, bloodwork etc...without your permission and showing the breakdown of the charges.
This is the way Veterinary Medicine should be practiced.
Although they couldn't help my dog ​​because of his age, I liked the service; they were good, attended to me quickly, and spoke Spanish.

Not one person of color working.
My cat died because of them.

I may have left a review already but I am so grateful to Dr. Valbuena for her care of my senior cat for dental extractions today and communication I had to leave another 5 star review. And the pricing for the extractions is the most reasonable I've ever encountered. So impressed. I'd go out of my way to work with Dr. Valbuena.
I have been taking my dog and cat here for many years. All the vets and techs we have worked with have been excellent, compassionate, informative, and understanding! I would highly recommend!
Great veterinary care for my dog.
Amazing vets, great service, welcoming and loving staff.

Can't say enough great things about them. They are always genuine in the care and comfort of my dog. They go out of their way to explain diagnosis, treatment options and  pricing. I value their friendly, honest, and thorough approach. I trust Dr Sullivan and team emphatically. Hands down, they are the best!

ABSOLUTELY EXTRAORDINARY! My dogs have been regular clients/patients for over ten years. Vet care is outstanding! Vet techs are amazing! Customer service reps are exceptional! I ALWAYS have a positive experience here and would not take my pets anywhere else. They treat pet patients and pet parents with the ultimate care and concern. Special thanks to Dr. Sullivan for going the extra mile for our dogs. I would give TEN STARS if I could. Without exception, this is the best vet clinic in Illinois!

AVOID THIS PLACE! IF YOU DO NOT WISH TO BE TAKEN ADVANTAGE OF AVOID THIS PLACE AT ALL COST. My brother took his cats here and they charged him $482.08 for RECOMMENDED VACCINES. this is a clinic so if they see that someone has hard time understanding them, they should have used an interpreter or at least a Google translate which is free. But they took advantage of the situation and gave all these vaccine to the cats just to overcharge and make money. Just because a pharmacy has many different vaccines doesn’t mean everyone is in line to get them or need them. I called and requested a refund, implying my understanding of the charge that must have been $195.08 but they gave me so much attitude and they hang up on me, nevertheless they claim that the person who was involved FELT CONFIDENT of my brother’s understanding because she is BILINGUAL! I speak 4 languages myself and work is customer service and this is unacceptable and ridiculous. Would a doctor diagnose you because he felt confident or he actually understood your situation? Making 0 sense and super ignorant, rude staff. I was speaking with Danielle on the phone and she hanged up the phone on me and ….. Avoid this place.
Keeping our pet happy and healthy. Staff is very friendly and knowledgeable
My pets have been patients since they opened. Excellent service and they're attentive to your pets' needs.
Nice staff quality veterinary team.
Very nice doctors and staff there. Got my pup shots and check up. Highly recommend for animals
